_README: Hand-authored ANALYSIS specs (sub-step 3c). Each entry is one analysis — a comparison/finding OVER conditions (leaderboard, hypothesis test, sweep, ...). The generator (scripts/generate_post_run_report.py) validates these, attaches provenance, and emits results/analyses-manifest.json (+ .md). HYBRID authoring: the machine-fillable keys (analysis_id, type, conditions_compared, output_path) are authored here; the human-authored fields (outcome, hypothesis_refs, preregistered, deviations, predicted_outcome, tie_set, paper_section, working_notes_obs) may stay null until a human writes the finding + preregistration linkage, per the schema's lenient back-fill. Set manually_verified_at when a human has authored/verified a row. Schema: docs/manifest-schemas/analyses-manifest.schema.json.

analyses._note: The N=1 single-pass baseline leaderboard at 384px (the cross-architecture model x modality x thinking x temperature matrix). FINDING (authored 2026-06-03): tie_set + outcome from a round-robin tile-swap permutation (replicate-mean per-tile, 10k perms, seed 42, two-sided) + Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (q=0.05) + greedy-clique tiering at the 20 m headline buffer -> 6 tiers; Tier 1 (tie_set) = the two Pro-text-low-temp leaders, BH-adjusted p=0.50 between them, both significantly clear of rank 3 (adj-p=0.0000). Result artefacts: results/paper-eval/n1/384px-14buf-mcc/tiering/tiering_20m.{json,md}; script: scripts/n1_baseline_leaderboard_tiering.py. This single-pass board is the baseline comparator the consensus (H3) and proposer-verifier (H2) architectures are measured against. See docs/methodology/n1-baseline-matrix.md and planning/leaderboard-construction-plan.md.
analyses.predicted_outcome: Preregistered directions come from Gemini-2.x-Flash / 512 px phases (this board is Gemini 3 at 384 px): H6 (Phase 4, the only untested confirmatory hypothesis) expected the stronger Pro model to transfer/match-or-exceed Flash; H7 (Phase 2b) found T=0.0 optimal for both tracks; H1 (Phase 2a) planned a text-only vs image-using contrast without a committed directional winner. Board result: H6 holds at the top (Pro text leads) but NOT uniformly -- Flash image-MINIMAL (F1 0.59-0.60) beats several weak Pro configs (Pro text high T=0.0 0.494; Pro image medium T=0.7 0.452; Pro text medium T=0.7 0.416); H7's T=0.0 advantage does not reappear at the top (the two tied leaders are T=0.0 and T=0.7); H1 resolves metric-dependently -- text wins F1@20 m localisation (Tier 1 is all text) while image wins MCC tile-discrimination (pro-image-high-t-0-7, MCC +0.852).
analyses.outcome: At the preregistered 20 m buffer the best single pass for mound localisation is Gemini 3 Pro text at low temperature: baseline-pro-text-medium-t-0-0 (F1 0.763) and baseline-pro-text-high-t-0-7 (F1 0.745) form a two-member statistical tie (round-robin tile-swap permutation, BH-FDR q=0.05; pair BH-adjusted p=0.50) significantly clear of all 16 other single-pass configurations, but the F1 leaders are not the tile-level discrimination (MCC) leader (pro-image-high-t-0-7, MCC +0.852, 7th on F1), so the best single-pass configuration is metric-dependent.
